result.summary: Found several visual defects: a nonsensical '-0%' badge, truncated restaurant names, and uneven image treatment that make the feed look broken.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a white badge reading '-0%', which is meaningless as a discount or promo and looks like bad or missing data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0, or show a real promo (e.g. '-20%') / remove the overlay entirely if there is no offer.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under the third 'Fastest near you' card, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis only after a complete word.

issues.description: Fastest-near-you card images are inconsistent: the poke bowl is washed out/low contrast while the burger and pasta look sharp, making the row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment (same crop, contrast, and overlay style) for all cards in the carousel.

issues.description: Category chips row ends with a partial empty/white chip on the right, which reads as a broken or incomplete control rather than intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chip padding and snap behavior so the last visible chip isn’t a blank fragment, or add clearer fade/scroll hinting.
